name: netintel-mcp
description: NetIntel MCP Server - pluggable open-source intelligence aggregation (Hacker News / GitHub / arXiv) over the Model Context Protocol 2025-06-18, with a zero-dependency hand-written JSON-RPC 2.0 core.

scripts.test:unit: npm run build && node --test dist/tests/protocol.core.test.js dist/tests/protocol.lifecycle.test.js dist/tests/protocol.pagination.test.js dist/tests/tools.registry.test.js dist/tests/tools.validation.test.js dist/tests/net.cache.test.js dist/tests/net.ranking.test.js dist/tests/net.sources.test.js dist/tests/resources.prompts.test.js
scripts.test:jsonrpc: npm run build && node --test dist/tests/jsonrpc.envelope.test.js dist/tests/jsonrpc.errors.test.js dist/tests/jsonrpc.fuzz.test.js dist/tests/transport.stdio.test.js dist/tests/transport.http.test.js
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run smoke
